column1: # Extended surfaceome: the SURFY list plus reviewed human proteins UniProt
# curates as located at the cell membrane (subcellular location SL-0039).
# Additive only: SURFY membership is preserved and identifiable in the
# `source` column, so a result can be reported against the original list,
# the extension, or both, and an earlier result stays reproducible.
# SURFY: Bausch-Fluck et al., PNAS 2018; no licence stated by the source (article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0).
